 牧羊人Shepherd：运行时基质为元代理提供形式化的执行跟踪: A Runtime Substrate Empowering Meta-Agents with a Formalized Execution Trace

Simon Yu∗†  Derek Chong∗‡  Ananjan Nandi∗‡
Dilara Soylu‡  Jiuding Sun‡  Christopher D Manning‡  Weiyan Shi†
†Northeastern University  ‡Stanford University
{yu.chi, we.shi}@northeastern.edu
{derekch, ananjan, soylu, sunjd24, manning}@stanford.edu
∗Equal contribution
摘要Abstract

随着基于法学硕士的代理系统变得越来越复杂，他们越来越依赖于As LLM-based agentic systems grow more complex, they increasingly rely on元代理meta-agents：对其他代理起作用的高阶代理，就像经理监督员工一样。 然而，现有的代理运行时仅将执行公开为静态环境状态，限制了元代理所需的实时和事后干预的类型。 为了解锁这些功能，我们引入: higher-order agents that act on other agents, much like managers supervise employees. Yet existing agentic runtimes expose execution only as static environmental states, limiting the kinds of live and post-hoc interventions a meta-agent requires. To unlock these capabilities, we introduce牧羊人Shepherd，一种函数式编程模型，它将目标代理上的元代理操作形式化为函数，并在精益中机械化核心操作。, a functional programming model that formalizes meta-agent operations on target agents as functions, with core operations mechanized in Lean.牧羊人Shepherd将每个代理与环境的交互记录为一个类似 Git 的有原则的执行跟踪中的类型化事件，其中任何过去的状态都可以廉价地分叉和重放。 即使在规模上，records every agent–environment interaction as a typed event in a principled Git-like execution trace where any past state can be cheaply forked and replayed. Even at scale,牧羊人Shepherd分叉代理进程及其文件系统forks the agent process and its filesystem5×5\times比 Docker 更快，faster than Docker, with>>重播时提示缓存重用率达到 95%。 我们举例说明95% prompt-cache reuse on replay. We exemplify牧羊人Shepherd在三个用例中的多功能性：(1)’s versatility in three use cases: (1)运行时干预runtime intervention，现场主管将 CooperBench 上的配对编码通过率从 28.8% 提高到 54.7%； (2), where a live supervisor improves pair coding pass rate from 28.8% to 54.7% on CooperBench; (2)反事实元优化counterfactual meta-optimization，元代理分支探索替代路径，在四个基准上击败 MetaHarness 和 GEPA 多达 11 个点，挂钟时间降低多达 58%；和（3）, where a meta-agent branches to explore alterative paths, beating MetaHarness and GEPA across four benchmarks by up to 11 points with up to 58% lower wall-clock; and (3)树强化学习训练Tree-RL training，其中元代理分叉在选定的回合推出，将 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上的 TerminalBench-2 从 34.2% 提升到 39.4%。 这些用例表明, where a meta-agent forks rollouts at chosen turns, lifting TerminalBench-2 from 34.2% to 39.4% on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. These use cases show牧羊人Shepherd是用于编程元代理的高性能且高效的基础；我们将其开源以推进未来的研究。is a performant and efficient substrate for programming meta-agents; we open-source it to advance future research.

Recent work implements pieces of this directly atop existing agentic runtimes (Table˜1): OpenHands 事件源 会话状态): OpenHands event-sources session state[37], AgentGit 提供工作代理 类似 Git 的提交工具, AgentGit gives worker agents Git-like commit tools[22]，并且 BranchFS 分支 文件系统, and BranchFS branches the filesystem[34]。但这些暴露出来的文物 运行时（转录本、工具、快照）主要是为了维护正在运行的代理的运行时状态而设计的。元代理的 要求不同：它需要. A meta-agent’s requirements are different: it needs the代理及其执行agent and its execution成为一个明确的、 它可以检查和操作的结构化一流对象。to be an explicit, structured first-class object it can inspect and operate on.

我们认为，缩小这一差距需要不同的视角：代理人和 它的执行可以像函数式编程中的函数一样得到一流的待遇，另一个函数（元代理）能够保存、调用、复制和重写它。我们建议We argue that closing this gap calls for a different perspective: An agent and its execution can be given the same first-class treatment as a function in functional programming, with another function (the meta-agent) able to hold, call, copy, and rewrite it. We propose 牧羊人Shepherd，一种基于函数式编程的高阶代理编程模型 并实例化为直观的 Python 框架（图, a programming model for higher-order agents grounded in functional programming and instantiated as an intuitive Python framework (Figure1, 部分, Section3).

的The牧羊人Shepherd运行时将代理定义为runtime defines agents as任务tasks具有类型化的输入和输出，并以类似 Git 的方式记录这些任务的执行with typed inputs and outputs, and records the execution of these tasks in a Git-like执行跟踪execution trace：每个动作都会成为一次提交，每个分叉都会打开 对于一个新分支，所有过去的代理环境状态都可以通过签出保持可达，并且任何状态重放都是准确的。 在这条轨迹上，一个元代理: every action becomes a commit, every fork opens a new branch, all past agent-environment state stays reachable through checkouts, and any replay of state is exact. Over this trace, a meta-agent读reads通过订阅来执行任务 其提交的类型化事件流；the execution of a task by subscribing to the typed event stream of its commits;倒带rewinds通过检查 较早的提交，恢复之前的确切状态；it by checking out an earlier commit, restoring the exact prior state;分支机构branches它由 分叉一个范围，其中包含工人的环境；和it by forking a scope, which carries the worker’s environment with it; and修改modifies通过重写任务定义本身来实现。我们的原则接地气 在函数式编程中给出了元代理it by rewriting the task definition itself. Our principled grounding in functional programming gives meta-agents in牧羊人Shepherd几个关键属性： 观察不会干扰工人的轨迹，树枝不会泄漏 变回到父级，并且倒带是精确的。 我们通过在精益中机械化的小型代数效应演算来形式化这些属性，它为类型化的效果痕迹提供了精确的语义契约，通过显式的证明信封在工件中浮现出来。实施是 轻量级：在 5.8GB docker 镜像上，耦合的 fork 捕获了工作进程 进程及其文件系统状态原子地位于several crucial properties: observation does not perturb a worker’s trajectory, branches cannot leak changes back into the parent, and rewinds are exact. We formalize these properties through a small algebraic-effects calculus mechanized in Lean, which provides a precise semantic contract for typed effect traces, surfaced in the artifact through explicit proof envelopes. The implementation is lightweight: on a 5.8 GB docker image, the coupled fork captures the worker process and its filesystem state atomically at5×5\times的速度the speed of a泊坞窗 提交docker commit，并重复使用, and reuses over95%95\%重播时 LLM 提供者的 KV 缓存。of the LLM provider’s KV cache on replay.

总之，我们贡献（i）In summary, we contribute (i) 牧羊人Shepherd，一种高阶代理的编程模型，其核心操作正式基于函数式编程并在精益中机械化； (ii) 实例化该模型的 Python 框架，其实现成本比现有运行时便宜几个数量级； (iii) 三个跨越代理生命周期的高性能元代理示例。, a programming model for higher-order agents whose core operations are formally grounded in functional programming and mechanized in Lean; (ii) a Python framework instantiating this model with an implementation orders of magnitude cheaper than existing runtimes; and (iii) three performant meta-agents examples spanning the agent lifecycle.

2 相关工作Related Work

元代理。Meta-Agents.

元代理应用程序在最近的工作中不断出现Meta-agent applications are emerging in recent work[45, 44]。达尔文-哥德尔机器. Darwin-Gödel Machines[47]和群体进化代理and Group-Evolving Agents[40]维护自修改代码的动态档案。超级代理maintain dynamic archives of self-modifying code. Hyperagents[48]和元线束and Meta-Harness[19]在元级别优化任务代理的问题解决策略。其他线路通过进化搜索来完善代理的上下文和长期检索optimize a task agent’s problem-solving strategies at the meta level. Other lines refine an agent’s context and long-term retrieval through evolutionary search[25, 38]或内存增强架构or memory-augmented architectures[50, 21, 51, 42, 39, 30]。所有这些都增加了元代理功能，例如应用层的自省和自我改进。. All of these add meta-agent capabilities like introspection and self-improvement at the application layer.牧羊人Shepherd是互补的：它提供了一个基础，使先前的元代理应用程序更容易构建，将观察、分叉和重放作为执行运行时的确定性原语公开，以便外部监督程序可以驱动探索和错误恢复。is complementary: it offers a substrate that makes prior meta-agent applications easier to build, exposing observation, forking, and replay as deterministic primitives in the execution runtime so an external supervisor can drive exploration and error recovery.

元优化。Meta-Optimization.

编排多个 LLM 代理是复杂任务解决和推理时间扩展的常见策略。标准多代理框架Orchestrating multiple LLM agents is a common strategy for complex task resolution and inference-time scaling. Standard multi-agent frameworks[41, 9, 1]在工作人员之间传递自然语言消息；库珀长凳route natural-language messages between workers; CooperBench[16]显示了该制度中可能出现的协调失败。管道优化器shows the coordination failures that can compound in this regime. Pipeline optimizers[15, 6, 52]和测试时间缩放方法and test-time scaling methods[17, 20]使用并行推出和多数投票，通过完整的端到端重新执行来评估每个候选人。盖帕use parallel rollouts and majority voting, evaluating each candidate by full end-to-end re-execution. GEPA[2]引入了一个反射元代理，它建议对工作流程进行编辑。这些方法将底层执行视为黑匣子，并从头开始重新运行候选者。introduces a reflective meta-agent that proposes edits to workflows. These methods treat the underlying execution as a black box and re-run candidates from scratch.牧羊人Shepherd添加了不同的评估原语：元代理可以在编辑首先改变行为的确切提交处分支工作人员的上下文，并仅重播受影响的后缀（adds a different evaluation primitive: a meta-agent can branch a worker’s context at the exact commit where an edit first alters behavior and replay only the affected suffix (Section˜4），因此候选人可以有效地重用计算。), so candidates reuse computation effectively.

代理运行时和基础设施。Agentic Runtime and Infrastructure.

并行的研究增加了对代理状态管理的基础设施支持，将检查点原语放置在软件堆栈的不同层。代理GitA parallel line of research adds infrastructure support for agentic state management, placing the checkpoint primitive at different layers of the software stack. AgentGit[22]将版本控制操作公开为代理可以从 LangGraph 工作流程中调用的协作工具。分支文件系统exposes version-control operations as cooperative tools the agent can invoke from within a LangGraph workflow. BranchFS[34]添加内核级adds a kernel-level分支()branch()隔离文件系统状态的系统调用，独立于工作程序的工具调用结构。代理SPEXsystem call that isolates filesystem state, independent of the worker’s tool-call structure. AgentSPEX[35]将检查点嵌入到代理工作流程的特定于域的语言中。其中每一个都将检查点原语放置在堆栈中的不同点，在代理自主性、透明度和语言级集成之间进行不同的权衡。embeds checkpointing into a domain-specific language for agent workflows. Each of these places the checkpoint primitive at a different point in the stack, with different trade-offs between agent autonomy, transparency, and language-level integration.牧羊人Shepherd位于此设计空间中的不同点：它将环境状态与代理执行的类型化效果流结合起来，因此底层可以观察工作人员发出的相同事件，而不需要从头开始重写或重放工作人员。效果流让相同的基质在统一的界面下支持实时监督、事后轨迹优化和有状态强化学习。sits at a different point in this design space: it couples environment states with the typed effect stream of agent executions, so the substrate observes the same events the worker emits without requiring the worker to be rewritten or replayed from scratch. The effect stream lets the same substrate support live supervision, post-hoc trajectory optimization, and stateful RL under a unified interface.

3 的The 牧羊人Shepherd编程模型Programming Model

现有的代理运行时是围绕帮助工作代理维护其自身状态而构建的：转录本捕获其所说的内容，快照捕获其停止的位置，工具日志捕获其调用的内容。然而，元代理需要不同的东西：工作人员及其执行本身作为一个结构化的、可检查的对象，它可以Existing agentic runtimes are built around helping a worker agent maintain its own state: a transcript captures what it said, a snapshot captures where it left off, and a tool log captures what it called. However, a meta-agent needs something different: the worker and its execution itself as a structured, inspectable object it can读read, 倒回rewind, 分行branch, 和, and修改modify。构建这样的对象对于代理执行来说很困难，因为它充满了副作用：模型调用、文件系统写入和工具调用。. Building such an object is hard for agentic execution because it is full of side effects: model calls, filesystem writes, and tool invocations.

函数式编程有着通过绘制分隔边界来构建有效计算的悠久传统。Functional programming has a long tradition of structuring effectful computation by drawing a boundary that separates什么what计算描述了a computation describes from如何how它的影响波及全世界。此边界内的计算变得可替代、可观察而无需扰动、可分支和可重放。its effects reach the world. Computation inside this boundary becomes substitutable, observable without perturbation, branchable, and replayable.牧羊人Shepherd将这一规则扩展到代理执行，将其视为一流的对象。这样做需要将四件事提升到一流地位：extends this discipline to agentic execution, treating it as a first-class object. Doing so requires elevating four things to first-class status: what the agentis (任务tasks, § 3.1），什么), what it确实does (效果effects, § 3.2），其中), where it运行runs (范围scopes, § 3.3），以及已经发生了什么), and what has been完成done (执行跟踪execution trace, § 3.4）。每个原语都基于函数式编程结构，并且其确定性核心). 3.2 效果：代理动作Effects: Agent Actions

元代理想要A meta-agent that wants to读read工人的行动需要每个行动都是结构化的、可观察的记录。在函数式编程中，a worker’s actions needs each action to be a structured, observable record. In functional programming,代数效应algebraic effects解决有效函数的类似问题：每个接触外界的操作都被记录为处理程序拦截的类型化事件，将意图（函数描述的内容）与执行（到达世界的内容）分开。solve the analogous problem for effectful functions: each operation that would touch the outside world is recorded as a typed event that a handler intercepts, separating intent (what the function describes) from execution (what reaches the world).牧羊人Shepherd将这一纪律应用于代理人。安applies this discipline to agents. An效果effect是工作人员采取或尝试的单个操作的类型化记录 - 模型调用、工具调用、环境突变或用户定义的自定义操作。工人发出的每个效果都会附加到is a typed record of a single action a worker took or attempted — a model call, a tool invocation, an environment mutation, or a user-defined custom action. Every effect a worker emits is appended to an效果流effect stream，元代理通过订阅流来读取该流。, and a meta-agent reads the stream by subscribing to it.

代理人的意图和结果是单独的事件。An agent’s intent and outcome are separate events.

工具调用会产生两种效果：一种是工作人员发出调用时（记录其要求的工具名称和参数），另一种是调用返回时（记录结果）。订阅的元代理看到意图与结果脱钩，这使得中间工具调用干预成为可能。A tool call emits two effects: one when the worker issues the call (recording the tool name and arguments it asked for) and one when the call returns (recording the result). A subscribed meta-agent sees the intent decoupled from the outcome, which makes mid-tool-call intervention possible.

在具体化之前，效果是可逆的。Effects are reversible until materialized.

可以交换处理程序以重新解释操作。Handlers can be swapped to reinterpret actions.

正如代数效应让函数的操作在不同的处理程序下得到不同的解释一样，元代理可以在不同的环境中重放工作人员的效果，同时保留工作人员的意图。Just as algebraic effects let a function’s operations be interpreted differently under different handlers, a meta-agent can replay a worker’s effects in a different environment, with the worker’s intent preserved.

观察是无干扰的。Observation is non-perturbing.

效果流是仅附加且不可变的。因此，无论元代理是否正在观看，工作人员的效果流都是字节相同的。元代理可以读取工人的行为并控制哪些行为到达世界，而不会影响工人本身。然而，为了跟踪先前的执行并尝试替代变体，元代理需要更多。The effect stream is append-only and immutable. Therefore, a worker’s effect stream is byte-identical whether or not a meta-agent is watching. A meta-agent can read a worker’s actions and gate which of them reach the world, without affecting the worker itself. However, to keep track of prior executions and try alternative variants, the meta-agent needs more.

3.3 范围：代理环境Scopes: Agent Environments

对于元代理来说，For a meta-agent,分支branching工作人员需要运行一个替代的延续，观察它的进展情况，然后保留或丢弃它。支持这一点的函数式编程结构是a worker requires running an alternative continuation, observing how it goes, and either keeping or throwing it away. The functional programming construct that supports this is the区域范围的处理程序region-scoped handler：一个隔离的执行区域，其中的效果由特定的处理程序解释。函数可以在该子区域内安装一个新的处理程序，在其中运行，然后向外传播该区域的效果或放弃它们。这些区域可以嵌套，每个级别都有自己的解释。: an isolated region of execution in which effects are interpreted by a specific handler. A function can install a fresh handler inside this sub-region, run inside it, and either propagate the region’s effects outward or abandon them. These regions can nest, with each level owning its own interpretation.

类似地，一个Analogously, a牧羊人Shepherd 范围scope是一个绑定环境（沙箱句柄、模型提供程序、工具表面），拥有在其中运行的任务发出的效果流。元代理通过四个原语在范围上运行：is a binding environment (sandbox handles, model providers, tool surfaces) that owns the effect stream emitted by tasks running inside it. 丢弃子进程后，父进程的字节与分叉时的字节相同。恢复还保留了工作人员的框架：由元代理恢复的暂停工作人员会看到其原始范围中记录的绑定，而不是元代理当前持有的任何内容。正如区域范围的处理程序干净地嵌套一样，每个级别都拥有自己的区域而不会污染其他区域，范围嵌套在Discarding a child leaves the parent byte-identical to the moment of fork. 3.4 执行跟踪：代理执行历史记录Execution Trace: Agent Execution History

元代理想要A meta-agent that wants to倒回rewind一个工作线程——返回到其执行的早期时刻，要么检查它，要么在不同的条件下从那里向前运行——需要按需访问该工作线程执行的每个过去状态。在函数式编程中，a worker — return to an earlier moment in its execution and either inspect it or run forward from there under different conditions — needs every past state of the worker’s execution to be reachable on demand. In functional programming,持久数据结构persistent data structures提供此属性：结构的每个版本在修改后仍然可访问，新版本与旧版本共享结构而不是复制。在provide this property: every version of the structure remains accessible after modification, with new versions sharing structure with old ones rather than copying. In牧羊人Shepherd，与此相对应的是, the counterpart to this is the执行跟踪execution trace。它是一个类似 Git 的持久提交图：每个范围的效果流具体化为图分支上的一系列类型化提交。 § 的四个范围操作. It is a persistent Git-like commit graph: each scope’s effect stream materializes as a sequence of typed commits on a branch of the graph. The four scope operations of §3.3然后也编译成类似 Git 的操作：then compile to Git-like operations as well:

⬇
1范围scope.发射emit(效果effect) ~ git 提交commit -m “<效果>”"<effect>"
2范围scope.叉子fork() ~ git 结账checkout -b <孩子child-分行branch>
3范围scope.合并merge(孩子child) ~ git 合并merge <孩子child-分行branch>
4范围scope.丢弃discard(孩子child) ~ git 分行branch -D <孩子child-分行branch>
每个过去的状态都是可到达和可重放的。Every past state is reachable and replayable.

元代理可以通过哈希导航到任何提交，并读取工作人员当时的确切状态，其完整范围完整。定位第一次出现回归的特定提交，或者两个兄弟姐妹开始分歧的地方，减少了跟踪上的图形遍历。从过去的提交重放也会在发散之前产生先前状态的字节精确重建，因此元代理支付的唯一成本是它实际执行的后缀。A meta-agent can navigate to any commit by hash and read the worker’s exact state at that moment, with its full scope intact. Locating the specific commit where a regression first appeared, or where two siblings began to diverge, reduces to graph traversal on the trace. Replaying from a past commit also produces a byte-exact reconstruction of the prior state before diverging, so the only cost paid by the meta-agent is the suffix it actually executes.

不同的分支按结构共享存储。Divergent branches share storage by structure.

正如持久数据结构跨版本共享子结构一样，执行跟踪跨分支共享存储：从同一提交分叉的两个兄弟通过内容哈希共享其整个前缀。跨多个分叉的元代理只需为实际分歧的后缀付费，并且任何一组分支都可以在效果级别上进行区分 - 让元代理根据其行为决定合并哪些分支。Just as persistent data structures share substructures across versions, the execution trace shares storage across branches: two siblings forked from the same commit share their entire prefix by content hash. A meta-agent fanning out across many forks pays only for the suffixes that actually diverge, and any set of branches can be diffed at the effect level — letting a meta-agent decide which to merge on the basis of their behavior.

库珀长凳CooperBench[16]文件adocuments a协调诅咒curse of coordination：并行编码代理的成功率低于单独代理，因为它们都无法观察或通信来说明它们的交互。: parallel coding agents succeed less often than solo agents because neither can observe or communicate to illustrate their interactions.牧羊人Shepherd的效果流和范围原语让元代理可以通过实时检查两个工作人员的执行情况并在损害复合之前进行干预来缩小这一差距。’s effect stream and scope primitives let a meta-agent close that gap by inspecting both workers’ execution in real time and intervening before damage compounds.

设置。Setup.

我们在 CooperBench 上进行评估We evaluate on the CooperBench[16]。两个 Claude Haiku 4.5 工作代理在并行分叉范围内运行，每个代理分配一项功能； Claude Sonnet 4.6 或 Opus 4.7 元代理通过以下方式订阅两个效果流. Two Claude Haiku 4.5 worker agents run in parallel forked scopes, each assigned one feature; a Claude Sonnet 4.6 or Opus 4.7 meta-agent subscribes to both effect streams via牧羊人Shepherd并提供三种协调工具：and is provided with three coordination tools:注入inject（将指导推入工人会议），(push guidance into the worker’s session),切换handoff（将领先工作人员的范围分叉为追随者的新根并重新启动），以及(fork the leading worker’s scope as the follower’s new root and restart), and丢弃discard（通过中止卡住的工人(abort a stuck worker via范围.discard()scope.discard()）。基线是). Baselines are独奏solo（一名俳句代理人依次处理这两个特征）和(one Haiku agent over both features sequentially) and鸡舍coop（两个并行俳句代理通过中继沙箱进行点对点消息传递，没有监督者）。完整的协议、数据集构建和每个条件的操作说明见附录(two parallel Haiku agents with peer-to-peer messaging via the relay sandbox, no supervisor). Full protocol, dataset construction, and per-condition operational notes are in AppendixE.

元代理的实时干预缩小了协调差距。Meta-Agents live intervention closes the curse-of-coordination gap.

在全部 479 对组中，合作基线达到 28.8% 的配对通过率，再现了 CooperBench 记录的协调罚分，而单人上限为 57.2%，显示出 28.4 分的差距。 Sonnet 元代理恢复了 45.3%，Opus 元代理达到 54.7%，结束On the full 479-pair set, the coop baseline lands at 28.8% pair pass rate, reproducing CooperBench’s documented coordination penalty against the solo ceiling of 57.2%, showing a 28.4-point gap. A Sonnet meta-agent recovers 45.3%, and an Opus meta-agent reaches 54.7%, closing91%91\%协调差距的诅咒（of the curse-of-coordination gap (Figure˜2，左）。挂钟成本适中：平均每对独奏需要 28.4 分钟，而监督条件保持接近平行合作基线（19.8 分钟）。 Sonnet 在 21.2 分钟（1.4 分钟元开销）内完成，Opus 在 24.2 分钟（4.3 分钟元开销）内完成，分别运行大约 75% 和 85% 的独奏时间（, left). The wallclock cost is modest: solo takes 28.4 min per pair on average, while the supervised conditions stay close to the parallel coop baseline (19.8 min). Sonnet finishes in 21.2 min (1.4 min meta overhead) and Opus in 24.2 min (4.3 min meta overhead), running at roughly 75% and 85% of solo time respectively (Figure˜2，对）。我们将此视为存在的证明，证明基板能够实现有效的实时监督；监督代币成本与任务执行成本的权衡是我们在附录中讨论的一个单独的问题, right). We treat this as a proof of existence that the substrate enables effective live supervision; the supervision token-cost vs. task-execution-cost trade-off is a separate question that we discuss in AppendixA.

5.2 用于元优化的元代理：反事实重放优化 (CRO)Meta-Agent for Meta-Optimization: Counterfactual Replay Optimization (CRO)

动机。Motivation.当代理工作流失败时，失败通常会追溯到 一小部分错误或丢失的座席呼叫When an agentic workflow fails, the failure usually traces to a small set of faulty or missing agent calls[46, 4]。反事实分析. Counterfactual analysis[33]提供了诊断此类故障的标准机制：对可疑调用集进行局部更改是否可以修复结果？在标准代理运行时回答这个问题是很困难的——工作流程重新运行会重新引入与编辑无关的随机和环境变化，并且平面转录几​​乎没有提供用于定位故障的结构。 CRO 通过分叉重放反事实来回避这两个问题provides standard machinery for diagnosing such failures: would a localized change to a suspect set of calls have fixed the outcome? Answering this in a standard agentic runtime is difficult – workflow re-runs reintroduce stochastic and environmental variation unrelated to the edit, and flat transcripts give little structure to localize failures against. CRO sidesteps both problems by replaying counterfactuals through forks of牧羊人Shepherd的执行跟踪，而不是从头开始重新执行更改的工作流程。’s execution trace rather than re-executing changed workflows from scratch.

方法。Method.

CRO 维护着一个工作流程变体池及其CRO maintains a pool of workflow variants together with their牧羊人Shepherd训练集上的执行跟踪。在每一步中，提议者都会分析这些痕迹来识别故障模式，选择父候选并发出一组候选编辑作为反事实实验来修补这些故障模式。每个编辑都与一个配对execution trace on the training set. At each step, the proposer analyzes these traces to identify failure modes, picks a parent candidate and emits a set of candidate edits as counterfactual experiments to patch these failure modes. Every edit is paired with a修复集fix set训练的 它应该修复的示例和of training examples it should repair and a守卫组guard set其表现不得 回归。whose performance must not regress.牧羊人Shepherd通过验证这些编辑validates these edits through反事实重播counterfactual replay上 组合的修复和保护集：对于每次编辑，它都会分叉父级的执行跟踪 在第一次提交时，将受到编辑的影响，并使用编辑后的工作流程重播后缀。在该组合集上优于其父代的候选者将在开发集上进行评估并添加到候选者池中；经过一定次数的迭代后，CRO 返回开发集上得分最高的成员作为选定的候选者（算法on the combined fix and guard set: for each edit, it forks the parent’s execution trace at the first commit that would be affected by the edit and replays the suffix with the edited workflow. Candidates that outperform their parent on this combined set are evaluated on the dev set and added to the candidate pool; after a set number of iterations CRO returns the highest-scoring member on the dev set as the selected candidate (Algorithm1、附录, AppendixF).

设置。Setup.

我们评估 HoVer 的子集We evaluate on subsets of HoVer[13], 数学, MATH[8], IFBench [27], 实时代码平台, LiveCodeBench[11]和 TerminalBench 2.0 (TB-2；, and TerminalBench 2.0 (TB-2;[24]), 将 CRO 与基线工作流程 GEPA（优化工作流程代码）进行比较), comparing CRO against the baseline workflow, GEPA (optimizing workflow code)[2], 和 元线束, and MetaHarness[19]。执行人是. The executor isGPT-5.4-迷你GPT-5.4-mini和 元优化器的使用and meta-optimizers useGPT-5.4（在 MetaHarness 和 GEPA 的 Codex 工具中）。我们在 HoVer、MATH、IFBench 和 LiveCodeBench 上达到 20 个候选后停止每个算法，在 TB-2 上达到 10 个候选后停止每个算法。每个数据集的设置、基线和完整结果位于附录中(in the Codex harness for MetaHarness and GEPA). We stop each algorithm after 20 candidates on HoVer, MATH, IFBench, and LiveCodeBench, and after 10 on TB-2. Per-dataset settings, baselines, and full results are in AppendixF.

结果。Results.

CRO 在五个数据集中的四个上获得了最佳性能（表CRO obtains the best performance on four of five datasets (Table3）。与这些数据集上的 MetaHarness 相比，它同时具有更高的保留测试分数和更低的挂钟，节省范围为 27-58%。值得注意的是，在 TerminalBench 2.0 上，该套件中最受执行限制的基准测试：GEPA 和 MetaHarness 都未能在所研究子集的基线上进行改进，而 CRO 将性能提高了 4 点，同时也需要最少的挂钟。在 IFBench 上，MetaHarness 在测试中比 CRO 领先 1.0 分（在标准差内），但仍需要比 CRO 长 37% 的时间。这些挂钟节省来自两个来源：反事实重播仅通过以下方式重新执行每个编辑的第一个效果下游的后缀). It has higher held-out test score and lower wallclock simultaneously compared to MetaHarness across these datasets, with savings ranging 27–58%. Notably, on TerminalBench 2.0, the most execution-bound benchmark in the suite: GEPA and MetaHarness both fail to improve over the baseline on the subset under study, while CRO improves performance by 4 pts while also needing the least wallclock. On IFBench, MetaHarness edges CRO by 1.0 pt on test (within a standard deviation) but still takes 37% longer. These wallclock savings come from two sources: counterfactual replay re-executes only the suffix downstream of each edit’s first effect via牧羊人Shepherd而不是完整的管道，目标集门控在进行完整的开发集评估之前，会根据训练集的一小部分来评估每个候选者。在 LiveCodeBench 上，计算重用源自rather than the full pipeline, and target-set gating evaluates each candidate against a small subset of the training set before committing to a full dev-set evaluation. On LiveCodeBench, computation reuse rises from∼\sim从第一次冷提议者会话的 1% 到运行后期的 60% 以上（图1% on the first cold proposer session to over 60% later in the run (Figure4）。更多详情请参见附录). More details in AppendixF.

5.3 用于训练的元代理：元代理引导树-RLMeta-Agent for Training: Meta-Agent Guided Tree-RL

动机。Motivation.

用于长视野任务的 RLVR 受到稀疏的、情节级奖励的困扰：执行数十步的代理最终会收到一个二进制信号RLVR for long-horizon tasks suffers from sparse, episode-level rewards: an agent that takes dozens of steps receives a single binary signal at the end[5, 36, 32]。对于细粒度的奖励信号，一种方法是树搜索强化学习. For fine-grained reward signals, one approach is Tree-search RL[10, 12]，它通过兄弟推出仅从结果奖励中获得阶梯级优势。在无状态环境中，这是微不足道的, which derives step-level advantages from outcome rewards alone via sibling rollouts. In stateless environments, this is trivial[43]。然而，对于修改真实文件系统和服务的代理任务，需要精确且廉价的状态分叉，这是由. However, with agent tasks that modify real filesystems and services, exact and cheap state-forking is required, which is provided by牧羊人Shepherd.

方法。Methods.

针对长视野代理样本的 GRPO 式训练GRPO-style training for long-horizon agents samplesGG每个提示的轨迹，并为每个提示分配一个结果奖励，均匀分布在所有操作中trajectories per prompt and assigns each one a single outcome reward, distributed uniformly across all actions[29]。我们通过树搜索中间状态来恢复更细粒度的信用. We recover finer-grained credit by tree-searching intermediate states[31, 53]：沿着每个根部署，元代理都会选择一个分叉转弯: along each root rollout, a meta-agent picks a fork turntt我们采样and we sampleKK兄弟姐妹从该状态向前分支，产生sibling branches forward from that state, yieldingG​(K+1)G(K{+}1)每个任务的轨迹仅花费trajectories per task at the cost of onlyKK额外的分支推出（分叉准确且便宜，extra branch rollouts (forking is exact and cheap,Table˜2）。信用分配在两个层面上进行：在之前添加前缀操作). Credit assignment operates at two levels: prefix actions beforett继承了标准跨根GRPO的优势inherit the standard inter-root GRPO advantage across theGG根，而后缀操作则采用每个树内计算的树内优势roots, while suffix actions take an intra-tree advantage computed within each(K+1)(K{+}1)-成员分叉组，在没有学习价值函数或过程奖励模型的情况下呈现每一步的结果差异。完整的过程作为算法给出-member fork group, surfacing per-step outcome differences without a learned value function or process reward model. 6 结论Conclusion

我们提出了We presented 牧羊人Shepherd，一个运行时，允许元代理将另一个代理的执行保存、检查、分支和重写为一流对象，就像函数式编程中的函数一样。元代理的原则是, a runtime that lets a meta-agent hold, inspect, branch, and rewrite another agent’s execution as a first-class object, like functions in functional programming. Meta-agents are principled in牧羊人Shepherd：它们是比代理执行更高阶的代理，一旦我们将执行本身视为一等值，支持监督的基础就与支持优化或强化学习的基础相同。本文中的三个用例，CooperBench 上的实时监控器、反事实重放元优化器 (CRO) 和元代理引导的 Tree-RL 训练器，都使用相同的: they are higher-order agents over agentic execution, and once we treat execution itself a first-class value, the substrate that supports supervision is the same one that supports optimization or RL. The three use cases in this paper, a live supervisor on CooperBench, a counterfactual-replay meta-optimizer (CRO), and a meta-agent-guided Tree-RL trainer, all use the same牧羊人Shepherd没有每个应用程序运行时工作的原语。除了三个示例应用程序之外，primitives with no per-application runtime work. Besides the three example applications,牧羊人Shepherd还解锁了代理可解释性、训练后和安全性方面的广泛未来工作，如附录中所述also unlocks a wide range of future work in agent interpretability, post-training, and safety, as discussed in AppendixA.

附录AAppendix A局限性和未来的工作Limitations and Future Works

A.1 局限性Limitations

存在证明框架。Proof-of-existence framing.

我们的三个案例研究中的每一个都被报告为存在的证明：考虑到我们为该案例编写的元代理，基底基元足以推动代表性数据集的有意义的提升。我们并不声称元代理策略的最优性、跨模型系列的鲁棒性以及基准扫描规模的基准，或者如果没有基准数据就无法匹配标题数据Each of our three case studies is reported as a proof of existence: the substrate primitives suffice to drive a meaningful uplift on a representative dataset, given a meta-agent we wrote for that case. We do not claim optimality of the meta-agent policies, robustness across model families and benchmarks at the scale of, e.g., a benchmark sweep, or that the headline numbers cannot be matched without牧羊人Shepherd。从与每一个看似合理的替代基础和政策进行面对面比较的意义上来说，建立完整的举证责任是每个案例研究的独立论文，超出了本工作的范围。. Establishing a full burden of proof, in the sense of head-to-head comparisons against every plausible alternative substrate and policy, is its own paper per case study and is outside the scope of this work.

监督和提议者成本。Supervision and proposer cost.

实时监督和 CRO 结果假设可以访问足够强大的元代理来发挥作用（第 § 中的 Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.7）The live-supervision and CRO results assume access to a meta-agent strong enough to act usefully (Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.7 in §5.1; GPT-5.4 中的§; GPT-5.4 in §5.2）。对于短期任务，元代理的代币成本可能超过工作人员的代币成本，就像现有的元优化器一样). For short tasks, the meta-agent’s token cost can exceed the worker’s, just as for existing meta-optimisers[2, 19]。我们在附录中报告了每臂的总美元成本. We report total dollar cost per arm in AppendixF.4;这种权衡有利的制度取决于任务长度以及工人和元代理之间的成本比率，我们在这里不进行描述。; the regime where this trade-off is favourable depends on task length and on the cost ratio between the worker and the meta-agent, which we do not characterise here.

反事实重放假设编辑和副作用之间的弱耦合。Counterfactual replay assumes weak coupling between edits and side effects.

CRO 从第一个依赖项受编辑影响的事件中重播候选编辑的后缀。当编辑触及影响广泛传播的组件时（例如，每个步骤中使用的工具的系统提示），后缀是整个轨迹，缓存不会购买任何东西。我们在每个数据集的冷第一个提议者会话中观察到这种制度（附录CRO replays a candidate edit’s suffix from the first event whose dependencies are affected by the edit. When an edit touches a component whose effects propagate widely (e.g. the system prompt of a tool used in every step), the suffix is the entire trajectory and the cache buys nothing. We observe this regime on the cold first proposer session of every dataset (AppendixF.4）；它会根据我们研究的基准在两到三个疗程内摊销。); it amortises away within two to three sessions on the benchmarks we study.

A.2 未来的作品Future Works

代理的可解释性。Agent interpretability.

当今代理系统的机械解释很大程度上是观察性的：对转录本进行注释，对探针进行拟合，并得出结论。Mechanistic interpretability of agentic systems today is largely observational: a transcript is annotated, a probe is fit, conclusions are drawn.牧羊人Shepherd的耦合分叉将这些变成可测试的反事实干预措施。编辑单个组件（工具、系统提示跨度、子任务定义）并重播其影响的第一个提交的后缀可以固定所有其他差异源，从而隔离该组件对最终结果的贡献。 CRO 的提议和重放机制是由任务成功目标驱动的循环的一个实例；自然的下一步是在可解释性目标下运行相同的循环，例如翻转特定决策的最小编辑，或删除其保留任务成功的最小提示跨度，将 CRO 变成解释而不是优化的工具。’s coupled fork turns these into testable counterfactual interventions. Editing a single component (a tool, a system-prompt span, a sub-task definition) and replaying the suffix from the first commit it affects holds every other source of variance fixed, isolating the contribution of that component to the eventual outcome. CRO’s propose-and-replay machinery is one instance of this loop driven by a task-success objective; a natural next step is to run the same loop under an interpretability objective, e.g. minimal edits that flip a specific decision, or the smallest prompt span whose removal preserves task success, turning CRO into a tool for explanation rather than optimisation.

用于持续学习的可逆环境。Reversible environments for continual learning.

Tree-GRPO 结果为 §The Tree-GRPO results in §5.3之所以有效，是因为分叉代理的文件系统和进程基本上是免费的。同样的原语适用于状态位于磁盘或沙盒进程树中的任何域：计算机使用、网页浏览和大型代码库编辑任务都适合。一旦分叉变得便宜，单个代理就可以训练数周的交互，而不是单个部署事件，并且执行跟踪维护每次重新访问、每次回溯和每次重试工具调用的连贯历史记录。然后，持续学习就变成了一个针对该图安排读取的问题，而不是重新设计底层。work because forking the agent’s filesystem and processes is essentially free. The same primitive applies to any domain whose state lives on disk or in a sandboxed process tree: computer-use, web browsing, and large-codebase edit tasks all fit. Once forks are cheap, a single agent can train over weeks of interaction rather than a single rollout episode, with the execution trace maintaining a coherent history of every revisit, every backtrack, and every retried tool call. Continual learning then becomes a question of scheduling reads against this graph rather than re-engineering the substrate.

后期训练剂使用基质。Post-training agents to use the substrate.

§中的案例研究The case studies in §5修复元代理并让它管理基础工作人员。双重问题是工人本身是否可以接受培训后使用fix the meta-agent and let it govern a base worker. The dual question is whether the worker itself can be post-trained to use牧羊人Shepherd原生的原语：一个动作空间，包括’s primitives natively: an action space that includes叉子fork, 丢弃discard, 和, and重播replayover its own typed effect stream, not just tool calls into the environment.这比工具使用后训练要困难得多，因为模型必须学习何时备份、何时重试以及何时生成同级，而不仅仅是调用哪个工具。基底准确地提供了定义这些动作并计算它们的精确回报所需的类型化状态。over its own typed effect stream, not just tool calls into the environment. This is strictly harder than tool-use post-training because the model has to learn when to back up, when to retry, and when to spawn a sibling, not just which tool to invoke. The substrate provides exactly the typed state needed to define these actions and to compute exact returns over them.

可逆沙箱作为安全属性。Reversible sandboxes as a safety property.

基材上的每个效应都带有可逆性层（§Every effect on the substrate carries a reversibility tier (§3.2)：可逆的文件系统突变、可补偿的副作用和不可逆的外部调用都有不同的回滚契约。这使得): reversible filesystem mutations, compensable side effects, and irreversible external calls each have a different rollback contract. This makes牧羊人Shepherd安全关键型代理部署的候选基础：外部覆盖可以抢占任何不可逆影响的实现，下游检查可以回滚到最后的实现点，执行跟踪为审计人员提供了实际发生情况的内容寻址记录，而不是代理报告的内容。底层不能解决对齐问题，但它使标准的停止和检查循环成为部署系统可以针对稳定接口而不是定制的每个代理管道实现的东西。a candidate substrate for safety-critical agent deployments: an external override can preempt the materialisation of any irreversible effect, downstream checks can fire a rollback up to the last materialisation point, and the execution trace gives auditors a content-addressed record of what actually happened rather than what the agent reported. The substrate does not solve the alignment problem, but it makes the standard halt-and-inspect loop something a deployment system can implement against a stable interface rather than bespoke per-agent plumbing.

C.2 不同突变大小下的底物缩放Substrate scaling under varying mutation size

审稿人自然会担心 10 KB 增量A natural reviewer concern about the 10 KB delta inTable˜2是当代理写入大文件时，基底是否保持较小。我们将 5.8GB pytorch-model-recovery 映像上的每步写入大小从 1KB 调整为 100MB，保持相同的 5+3 突变模式，但更改每次写入放入工作目录的字节数。is whether the substrate stays small when the agent writes large files. We sweep the per-step write size from 1 KB to 100 MB on the 5.8 GB pytorch-model-recovery image, keeping the same 5+3 mutation pattern but changing how many bytes each write puts into the workdir.Table˜6报告每个大小的三次重复所产生的覆盖磁盘增量和分叉延迟。reports the resulting overlay disk delta and fork latency across three repetitions per size.

有两个发现：(a) 磁盘增量以 1:1 的比例跟踪代理写入的内容（每步 1 KB 时为 8 KB，每步为 100 MB 时为 800 MB），因此基质在代理实际排放量之外增加了零开销； (b) 分叉和恢复延迟保持平稳Two findings: (a) the disk delta tracks what the agent writes 1:1 (8 KB at 1 KB/step up to 800 MB at 100 MB/step), so the substrate adds zero overhead beyond the agent’s actual emissions; (b) fork and revert latency stay flat at∼\sim所有大小均为 340 毫秒，因为这两个操作仅交换覆盖元数据，而不是文件内容。我们还验证了同一扫描的恢复正确性：在跨越所有四种大小的 12 次重复中，恢复后的工作目录与分叉前状态完全匹配（保留 5 个基线文件，完全丢弃 3 个分叉后分支文件；12/12 通过）。这里的绝对延迟大约比340 ms across all sizes, since both operations only swap overlay metadata, not file contents. We additionally verify revert correctness across the same sweep: in 12 reps spanning all four sizes, the workdir after revert exactly matches the pre-fork state (5 baseline files preserved, 3 post-fork branch files cleanly discarded; 12/12 PASS). Absolute latencies here are about 200 ms higher thanTable˜2因为这次扫描在 Mac/Docker Desktop 的 Linux VM 上运行，这增加了because this sweep ran on Mac/Docker Desktop’s Linux VM, which adds码头执行者docker exec每次调用的开销；缩放形状如表所示。overhead per call; the scaling shape is what the table claims.

动机。Motivation.

许多现实世界的代理任务是Many real-world agent tasks are可重复的repeatable：一类错误修复、一类数据处理脚本、一类构建环境错误。智能体找到的第一个解决方案通常充满了探索，但回想起来，它并不需要：冗余探测、死胡同假设、收敛前的试错。我们询问元代理是否可以通过效果流读取完整的轨迹来识别分叉点和提示，以便工作人员恢复到: a class of bug fixes, a class of data-processing scripts, a class of build-environment errors. The first solution an agent finds is typically full of exploration it did not, in retrospect, need: redundant probes, dead-end hypotheses, trial-and-error before convergence. We ask whether a meta-agent reading the completed trajectory through the effect stream can identify a fork point and a hint such that the worker, restored to the牧羊人Shepherd范围在这一点上并给出提示作为系统提示附录，以严格更少的步骤达到相同的任务结果；即scope at that point and given the hint as a system-prompt addendum, reaches the same task outcome in strictly fewer steps; i.e.,压缩compresses轨迹。the trajectory.牧羊人Shepherd每一步的’s per-step牧羊人Shepherd快照使这一点变得便宜：元代理不需要在轨迹收集时提交分叉点，并且重新运行仅支付后缀成本。压缩轨迹是否可以推广到可重用的工作流程以供将来调用同一任务类，这是我们悬而未决的后续问题。snapshots make this cheap: the meta-agent need not commit to a fork point at trajectory-collection time, and the rerun pays only the suffix cost. Whether a compressed trajectory generalises to a reusable workflow for future invocations of the same task class is a follow-up question we leave open.

这些提示具有三个共同特征：它们命名特定的文件路径The hints share three traits: they name a specific file path on/测试台/testbed，他们将更改描述为代码级意图而不是差异，事后的内容是工作人员希望它知道要进入的内容（要避免导入哪个库，要与函数的哪个先前版本进行比较，不要走哪些弯路）。提示不包含代码形式的解决方案；它们是重播工作人员仍必须转化为编辑的指导。, they describe the change as a code-level intent rather than a diff, and the hindsight content is what the worker wishes it had known going in (which library import to avoid, which previous version of a function to compare against, which detours not to take). D.4 最好的-Best-of-NN控制control

为了排除“工人分布中已经存在较短的通过基线，而元代理只是对其进行采样”的假设，我们运行了一项独立的最佳-To rule out the hypothesis that “a shorter passing baseline already exists in the worker’s distribution and the meta-agent is merely sampling it,” we ran an independent best-of-NN控制：对于至少有一个通过基线的每项任务，我们进行采样control: for each task with at least one passing baseline, we sampleN=5N{=}5同一工作人员的额外新基线推出（无元代理，无分叉，相同的系统提示和提供商默认温度），并在结果样本中选择最短的通过推出。然后我们比较最短传递-additional fresh baseline rollouts of the same worker (no meta-agent, no fork, identical system prompt and provider-default temperature), and select the shortest passing rollout among the resulting samples. We then compare the shortest-passing-of-NN长度与元代理在同一任务上重新运行的长度的关系。length against the meta-agent rerun length on the same task.

覆盖范围。Coverage.

Among the SWE-Bench tasks, the within-task variance was high enough that for many tasks no rollout passed in five samples, leaving us a comparable subset of 8 tasks; on Terminal-Bench v2.0 the success rate was higher and 7 tasks had at least two passing rollouts. 在可比较的子集中，最短传递 5 的长度平均在每个任务基线平均值的 1-2 次模型调用内，并且本质上永远不会短于同一任务上的元代理重新运行。具体来说，在七个 Terminal-Bench v2.0 任务上On the comparable subset, the shortest-passing-of-5 length is on average within 1–2 model calls of the per-task baseline mean and is essentially never shorter than the meta-agent rerun on the same task. Concretely, on the seven Terminal-Bench v2.0 tasks with≥2\geq 2通过推出，最短的 5 次传递长度为 5.6 次调用，每个任务的基线平均值为 5.7 次；同一组上的元代理重新运行长度为 4.4 次调用。因此，该控制恢复了相对于平均基线的一小部分差距，但没有缩小与元代理重新运行的差距，而这正是压缩率声明所依赖的。成本分解为passing rollouts, the shortest-passing-of-5 length is 5.6 calls and the per-task baseline mean is 5.7; the meta-agent rerun length on the same set is 4.4 calls. D.5 叉步分布Fork-step distribution

Figure˜5隐藏元代理选择分叉的轨迹中的位置。我们在这里总结了分布。在两个基板上和两个工作单元上，大约三分之一的压缩轨迹在hides where in the trajectory the meta-agent chose to fork. We summarise the distribution here. On both substrates and across both worker cells, roughly one third of compressed trajectories are forked atf=0f{=}0（从原始系统提示符和任务中完全重新启动，并预先添加提示），三分之一在轨迹的前半部分分叉（早期前缀保留），三分之一在中点或中点以上分叉（后期前缀保留）。该选择跟踪定性形状(full restart from the original system prompt and task with the hint prepended), one third are forked in the first half of the trajectory (early-prefix retention), and one third are forked at or beyond the midpoint (late-prefix retention). The choice tracks the qualitative shapes ofSection˜D.2：当整个基线路径可丢弃时完全重新启动；早期分叉，只有开始的探索性转弯才有用；当工人的诊断基本上正确但轨迹的后半部分发生剧烈变化时，就会发生晚分叉。我们没有在提示中限制分叉步骤的选择；传播是元代理产生的。: full restarts when the entire baseline path was discardable; early forks when only the opening exploratory turns were useful; and late forks when the worker’s diagnostic was substantively right but the second half of the trajectory thrashed. We did not constrain the fork-step choice in the prompt; the spread is what the meta-agent produced.

费用备注。Cost note.

因为重新运行是从分叉开始的Because the rerun starts from a forked牧羊人Shepherd范围和恢复的前缀，其 API 成本只是后缀调用的成本，加上元代理读取轨迹并发出 JSON 的一次诊断调用的成本。在 Sonnet SWE-Bench Verified 单元上，在考虑提供商端前缀缓存之前，同一任务的中位重新运行成本大约是中位基线成本的三分之一。我们省略了精确的成本表，因为元代理的高推理诊断调用在我们的样本中主导了每个任务的成本差异，但重新运行比从头开始重新执行更便宜的定性主张在两个基底上都是稳健的。scope and a restored prefix, its API cost is the cost of the suffix calls only, plus the cost of the meta-agent’s one diagnostic call to read the trajectory and emit the JSON. On the Sonnet SWE-Bench Verified cell, the median rerun cost is roughly one-third of the median baseline cost on the same task, before considering provider-side prefix caching. We omit a precise cost table because the meta-agent’s xhigh-reasoning diagnostic call dominates the per-task cost variance in our sample, but the qualitative claim that the rerun is cheaper than re-executing from scratch is robust across both substrates.

我们使用 CooperBench 的完整结构冲突分割：公开版本中的每个（存储库、任务、功能对）元组，其两个真实补丁在独立应用时会产生 git 合并冲突。在删除 opencode 当前未安装的两个特定于 Go 的存储库（Alpine/musl ABI 不匹配）后，25 个存储库中的拆分为 479 对。同一组用于We use the full structurally-conflicting split of CooperBench: every (repo, task, feature-pair) tuple from the public release whose two ground-truth patches produce a git merge conflict when applied independently. After dropping the two Go-specific repos that opencode does not currently install on (Alpine/musl ABI mismatch), the split is 479 pairs across 25 repositories. The same set is used for独奏solo, 鸡舍coop，以及两个监督条件；配对身份保持不变，因此比较是配对的。每对补丁均使用 CooperBench 发布的工具进行评估：两个补丁通过以下方式合并：, and the two supervised conditions; pair identity is held constant so comparisons are paired. Per-pair patches are evaluated with CooperBench’s published harness: the two patches are merged viagit 合并文件git merge-file（使用 Qwen 1.5B 简单冲突解析器），检查合并树，并运行每个功能的 pytest 工具；当且仅当两个功能测试都通过时，一对才通过。(with a Qwen 1.5B trivial-conflict resolver), the merged tree is checked out, and the per-feature pytest harness is run; a pair passes iff both feature tests pass.

沙箱布局、利用和超时。Sandbox layout, harness, and timeouts.

每对运行在三个 E2B Linux 沙箱上：每个工作人员一个（单独的 OverlayFS，因此两个工作人员无法看到彼此的编辑），一个共享Each pair runs on three E2B Linux sandboxes: one per worker (separate OverlayFS, so the two workers cannot see each other’s edits) and one shared继电器relay托管 HTTP 消息总线和可选 MCP 合作服务器的沙箱sandbox that hosts an HTTP message-bus and the optional MCP coop-server used by the鸡舍coop基线。工作人员运行开放代码工具（固定到baseline. Workers run the opencode harness (pinned to最新的latest调试空响应回归后after debugging an empty-response regression inv1.4.0）针对 OpenRouter 路由的 Anthropic Haiku 4.5 模型，编排器每 10 秒通过 HTTP 轮询每个 opencode 会话，当最新的辅助消息在连续三个轮询中字节相同时，将会话视为“已解决”。每对挂钟预算为 3,300 秒（略低于 E2B 的 3,600 秒沙盒生命周期上限），每个工作线程的内部预算为 3,000 秒；超出任一预算的会话将被记录为失败。) against an OpenRouter-routed Anthropic Haiku 4.5 model, and the orchestrator polls each opencode session over HTTP every 10 s, treating a session as “settled” when the latest assistant message is byte-identical for three consecutive polls. Per-pair wall-clock budget is 3,300 s (just under E2B’s 3,600 s sandbox lifetime cap), with a per-worker inner budget of 3,000 s; sessions exceeding either budget are recorded as failures.

每 5 秒，编排器就会构建一个涵盖该对中所有代理的组合快照，并在每个周期调用元代理 LLM 一次（跨代理进行批处理，以保持工作人员数量中的主管代币成本持平）。对于每个代理，快照包括：功能描述（截断为 350 个字符）、累积事件计数、连续错误计数、代理的修改文件集、元代理对该代理的最近操作以及发出的时间间隔，以及尾随 25 个工具调用摘要（工具名称、状态、主要目标文件或命令、短错误（如果有））。每次调用被削减到大约 150 个字节，即使有 10 个代理在飞行，每次滴答提示也保持在 3K 令牌以下。工具调用是从 opencode 的 SSE 事件流中获取的；仅Every 5 s the orchestrator builds one combined snapshot covering all agents in the pair and calls the meta-agent LLM once per tick (batched across agents to keep supervisor token cost flat in worker count). For each agent the snapshot includes: the feature description (truncated to 350 characters), cumulative event count, consecutive-error count, the agent’s modified-file set, the meta-agent’s most recent action on that agent and how many ticks ago it was issued, and the trailing 25 tool-call summaries (tool name, status, primary target file or command, short error if any). Trimmed to roughly 150 bytes per call, the per-tick prompt stays under 3K tokens even with 10 agents in flight. Tool calls are ingested from opencode’s SSE event stream; only消息.部分.更新message.part.updated事件与events with a工具tool保留有效负载，并在源处过滤掉文本增量和生命周期事件。payload are kept, with text deltas and lifecycle events filtered out at the source.

F.2 实施细节Implementation Details

CRO 是一种编码代理元优化器。给定基线工作流程 表示为 Python 任务图、训练和开发划分以及指标 可调用，它产生一个优化的工作流程，在开发上得分更高。从实施的角度来看，CRO 与 MetaHarness 属于同一家族CRO is a coding-agent meta-optimiser. Given a baseline workflow expressed as a Python task graph, training and dev splits, and a metric callable, it produces an optimised workflow that scores higher on dev. From an implementation standpoint, CRO sits in the same family as MetaHarness[19]和追踪and Trace[6]：提议者是一个编码代理 在真正的 Python 源代码树上运行的 shell、读取和编辑工具， 而不是具有固定模式的即时重写法学硕士。因为每一个工作流程 执行记录在: the proposer is a coding agent with shell, read, and edit tools operating on a real Python source tree, rather than a prompt-rewriting LLM with a fixed schema. Because every workflow execution is recorded in牧羊人Shepherd的效果流，提议者 对之前的运行具有类型化、可查询的读取访问权限 - 每个示例 LLM I/O， 每个任务的源快照、先前候选人的分类账及其 接受/存档决策——并将每个提案基于之前的内容 尝试确实做到了，而不是从头开始重新推导假设 在每次迭代中。在本节中，我们提供有关 CRO 实施的更多详细信息。’s effect stream, the proposer has typed, queryable read access to prior runs — per-example LLM I/O, per-task source snapshots, ledgers of prior candidates and their accept/archive decisions — and grounds each proposal in what previous attempts actually did, rather than re-deriving hypotheses from scratch on each iteration. In this section, we provide more details regarding CRO’s implementation.

F.2.4 反事实重播Counterfactual replay

A 反事实的counterfactualdev 评估仅重新执行以下子树 受变体编辑影响的任务 DAG；其余的被重复使用 父母的踪迹。该机制是类型化缓存而不是 差异启发式。每个dev evaluation re-executes only the subtree of the task DAG affected by the variant’s edits; the rest is reused from the parent’s trace. The mechanism is a typed cache rather than a diffing heuristic. Each@代理@agent类由一对键控class is keyed by a pair(source-hash,inputs-hash)(\text{source-hash},\ \text{inputs-hash});源哈希捕获 任务类的源加上它传递引入的导入，以及 输入哈希捕获调用任务的类型化输入包 与.顶级管道的缓存键是其自身的组合 源哈希和每个子任务的源哈希，因此任何源编辑都会到达 管道级密钥。因此，编辑一个子任务会使该子任务无效 子任务的缓存和管道的缓存，但留下同级子任务 符合命中资格；他们的输入不会改变，除非编辑的任务位于 DAG 中通往它们的路径。编辑; the source-hash captures the task class’s source plus the imports it transitively pulls in, and the inputs-hash captures the typed input bundle the task is invoked with. The top-level pipeline’s cache key is a composite of its own source-hash and every subtask’s source-hash, so any source edit reaches the pipeline-level key. Editing one subtask therefore invalidates that subtask’s cache and the pipeline’s cache, but leaves sibling subtasks hit-eligible; their inputs are unchanged unless the edited task lies on a path to them in the DAG. Editing管道.pypipeline.py本身 使管道级缓存失效，但保留所有子任务缓存 符合命中条件。itself invalidates the pipeline-level cache but leaves all subtask caches hit-eligible.

对于变体目标集中的每个示例，宿主都会水合 重播存储与父级的每个任务输出，交换变体的 编辑受影响子任务的源，并重新执行管道。 复合键仍与缓存条目匹配的子任务返回其 无需 LLM 调用即可记录输出；仅受影响的子树 产生新的执行。因此，目标预检是严格的 比完全重新运行便宜，并添加新的For each example in a variant’s targeted set, the host hydrates the replay store with the parent’s per-task outputs, swaps in the variant’s edited source for the affected subtask(s), and re-executes the pipeline. Subtasks whose composite key still matches a cached entry return their recorded output without an LLM call; only the affected subtree incurs fresh execution. The targeted preflight is therefore strictly cheaper than a full re-run, and adding a new@代理@agent两个之间 现有的结构性举措是最便宜的结构性举措，因为 邻居的缓存在编辑后仍然存在。 CRO 的主文本缓存命中率 图（图 4）绘制了一段时间内实现的平均重用百分比 提案人会议。between two existing ones is the cheapest structural move available, since both neighbours’ caches survive the edit. CRO’s main-text cache-hit-rate figure (Figure 4) plots the realised reuse percentage averaged over a proposer session.

该机制是三个结构添加的序列，每个结构添加 解决通过 CRO 的影响追踪到的独特故障集群 ledger：一个 LLM 桥解析器，可在外部显示黄金页面 TF-IDF候选名单；一个 确定性片段基础，使用本地维基百科数据库 消除 hop-1 摘要中暴露的表面形式提及的歧义 （案例 2）；以及挖掘的递归关系感知桥扩展 来自接地一阶页面的二阶桥接页面（案例 3）。The mechanism is a sequence of three structural additions, each addressing a distinct failure cluster traced through CRO’s effect ledger: an LLM bridge resolver that surfaces gold pages outside the TF-IDF candidate list; a deterministic snippet grounder that uses a local Wikipedia DB to disambiguate surface-form mentions exposed by the hop-1 summary (Case 2); and a recursive relation-aware bridge expansion that mines second-order bridge pages from grounded first-order pages (Case 3).

从 LiveCodeBench v6 中均匀随机采样 100/100/100 释放。衡量标准是二进制通过所有测试：候选程序是 评分依据 公共和私人测试用例的联合（每个测试用例最多八个测试） 问题）；仅当每个测试都通过时，运行得分为 1.0。种子 工作流程是一个四任务管道——一个 LLM 求解器、一个确定性求解器 公共测试运行者，公共测试反馈的法学硕士检查员，以及 如果检查员要求进行一次修订尝试。请注意， 公制等级100/100/100 sampled uniformly at random from the LiveCodeBench v6 release. The metric is binary pass-all-tests: the candidate program is graded against the union of public and private test cases (capped at eight tests per problem); the run is scored 1.0 only when every test passes. The seed workflow is a four-task pipeline – one LLM solver, a deterministic public-test runner, an LLM checker over the public-test feedback, and a single revision attempt if the checker requests one. 150/300/294 来自 GEPA 论文。 294 个实例的测试拆分是完整的 IFBench 分布外约束集（58 OOD 约束 标识符）； train 和 dev 是切片150/300/294 vendored from the GEPA paper. The 294-instance test split is the full IFBench out-of-distribution constraint set (58 OOD constraint identifiers); train and dev are slices ofIFBench_train.jsonl。 该指标是按约束通过率计算为 满足 IFBench 的八个标准化响应变体 参考验证器，对声明的约束进行平均 示例。基线是. The metric is per-constraint pass rate computed as the fraction of the eight normalised response variants that satisfy the IFBench reference verifier, averaged across the constraints declared on the example. 该机制是引入明确的、门控的审核和修复 阶段：The mechanism is the introduction of an explicit, gated audit-and-repair stage:审计回应AuditResponse阅读原文中的约束 提示并对候选人的回答做出结构化的判断； 在一个reads the constraints in the original prompt and emits a structured verdict over the candidate response; on a失败FAIL, 修复响应RepairResponse用光重写响应 第二次审核前的裁决；下一秒rewrites the response in light of the verdict before a second audit; on a second失败FAIL, 完成响应FinalizeResponse执行约束重写条件 审计历史记录和原始草案。performs a constrained rewrite conditioned on both the audit history and the original draft.

终端工作台 2.0。TerminalBench 2.0.

我们逐字遵循 MetaHarness 协议：25 任务 Stable25 子集（We follow the MetaHarness protocol verbatim: the 25-task Stable25 subset (脚本/upstream_terminus2/_examples.pyscripts/upstream_terminus2/_examples.py) 用作 优化拆分和报告拆分。故意的 重叠是与 MetaHarness 的典型同类比较 这个基准；方法之间的任何差异均归因于 优化器而不是保持泛化差距。指标是 规范 Terminus-2 测试套件上的 avg@5：每个任务都会重播 执行器模型下五次，每个任务的通过率为 在对 25 项任务进行平均之前，先对五次试验进行平均。) is used as both the optimisation split and the reporting split. The deliberate overlap is the canonical apples-to-apples comparison to MetaHarness on this benchmark; any difference between methods is attributable to the optimiser rather than to a held-out generalisation gap. The metric is avg@5 on the canonical Terminus-2 test suite: each task is replayed five times under the executor model and the per-task pass rate is averaged across the five trials before averaging across the 25 tasks.

F.5 案例研究：HoVer 上可解释的反事实工作流程编辑Case Studies: Interpretable Counterfactual Workflow Edits on HoVer

我们总结了 CRO 在 HoVer 上发现的三个反事实工作流程编辑。 该指标是开发集黄金文档覆盖率超过 300 个示例。基线 检索工作流程评分We summarize three counterfactual workflow edits discovered by CRO on HoVer. The metric is dev-set gold-document coverage over 300 examples. The baseline retrieval workflow scored0.4470.447开发准确度（dev accuracy (134/300134/300).

F.5.1 案例 1：工作流程意外关闭Case 1: The Workflow Was Accidentally Candidate-Closed

诊断。Diagnosis.

基线失败主要不是因为模型无法推理 多跳索赔。相反，它经常识别或暗示缺失的桥梁 实体，但随后丢弃它，因为后面的阶段被迫选择 仅来自上游 TF-IDF 候选列表。这就产生了系统化的 “缺少要求”失败，例如金证包含的案件 页面如The baseline was not primarily failing because the model could not reason over multi-hop claims. Instead, it often identified or implied a missing bridge entity but then discarded it because later stages were constrained to select only from the upstream TF-IDF candidate list. This produced systematic “missing requirement” failures, e.g. cases where the gold evidence contained pages such as比利·艾多尔Billy Idol, 碰撞（电影）Collide (film), 或, or索尔·梅茨斯坦Saul Metzstein仅候选选择器未保留这些内容。that were not preserved by the candidate-only selector.

法学硕士如何得出诊断。How the LLM arrived at the diagnosis.

CRO 提议者检查了基线痕迹并观察到摘要经常 包含足够的语义证据来命名缺失的桥页，而 工作流程合同仍然需要“仅准确的候选人头衔”。因此它 假设瓶颈不仅仅是检索广度，而是 工作流程级别类型错误：恢复的维基百科标题被视为 除非他们出现在原始候选人名单中，否则不予受理。The CRO proposer inspected baseline traces and observed that summaries often contained enough semantic evidence to name a missing bridge page, while the workflow contract still required “exact candidate titles only.” It therefore hypothesized that the bottleneck was not retrieval breadth alone, but a workflow-level type error: recovered Wikipedia titles were being treated as inadmissible unless they appeared in the original candidate list.

生成的补丁。Generated patch.

CRO 添加了桥接标题恢复阶段并放松了选择器，以便它可以 保留在工作流程中恢复的接地维基百科标题：CRO added a bridge-title recovery stage and relaxed the selector so it could retain grounded Wikipedia titles recovered during the workflow:

bridge_titles = BridgeTitleResolver(
      claim=claim,
      retrieved_titles=first_retrieved,
      evidence_summary=first_summary,
  ).titles

  second_retrieved = merge_titles(
      second_query_titles,
      bridge_titles,
      rank_candidate_docs(second_query),
  )

  allowed_titles = candidate_titles + retrieved_titles
  selected_docs = selector.select(claim, allowed_titles, summaries)

关键的变化是检索到的非候选标题变为一流 证据候选人而不是在最终选择之前被丢弃。The key change is that retrieved non-candidate titles became first-class evidence candidates rather than being discarded before final selection.

电梯。Lift.

该补丁提高了开发覆盖率This patch raised dev coverage from0.4470.447 to 0.6930.693 (134/300134/300 to 208/300208/300），一个), a+24.7+24.7提高一个百分点。percentage point improvement.

F.5.2 案例 2：工作流程可以诊断其自身缺失的证据Case 2: The Workflow Could Diagnose Its Own Missing Evidence

诊断。Diagnosis.

开放世界桥梁修复后，许多残留故障不再存在 第一跳检索失败。之后工作流程已经积累了足够的上下文 两个摘要来描述仍然缺少的内容，但没有任何阶段可以转换该内容 自我诊断为接地页面标题。例子包括缺失的证据 页面如After open-world bridge recovery, many residual failures were no longer first-hop retrieval failures. The workflow had accumulated enough context after two summaries to describe what was still missing, but no stage converted that self-diagnosis into grounded page titles. Examples included missing evidence pages such as淮南Huainan, 豪威亚Howea, 石豆兰属Bulbophyllum, 和, and索尔·梅茨斯坦Saul Metzstein.

法学硕士如何得出诊断。How the LLM arrived at the diagnosis.

提议者比较了成功和失败候选人的痕迹并注意到 摘要中重复使用了诸如“缺失桥梁事实”之类的短语或 直接命名未解析的实体。据推断，工作流程需要 后期审核步骤：积累足够的证据后，明确询问什么 文件仍然缺失，然后将那些短表面形式磨平 本地维基百科标题数据库。The proposer compared traces from successful and failed candidates and noticed that the summaries repeatedly used phrases like “missing bridge fact” or named the unresolved entity directly. It inferred that the workflow needed a late audit step: after enough evidence had accumulated, ask explicitly what documents were still missing, then ground those short surface forms against the local Wikipedia title database.

生成的补丁。Generated patch.

CRO 在第二个摘要和第二个摘要之间插入了一个缺失证据解析器 第三个检索跃点：CRO inserted a missing-evidence resolver between the second summary and the third retrieval hop:

gap_titles = MissingEvidenceResolver(
      claim=claim,
      retrieved_titles=merge_titles(first_retrieved, second_retrieved),
      evidence_summary=first_summary + "\n\n" + second_summary,
  ).titles

  third_retrieved = merge_titles(
      gap_titles,
      third_query_titles,
      rank_candidate_docs(third_query),
  )

解析器被提示返回短曲面形式而不是猜测 附加标题，然后工作流程确定性地基于这些 表面到确切的本地维基百科页面。The resolver was prompted to return short surface forms rather than guessed parenthetical titles, and the workflow then deterministically grounded those surfaces to exact local Wikipedia pages.

电梯。Lift.

相对于之前的桥接恢复前沿，此补丁提高了开发人员 覆盖范围来自Relative to the previous bridge-recovery frontier, this patch raised dev coverage from0.7370.737 to 0.7870.787 (221/300221/300 to 236/300236/300），一个), a+5.0%+5.0\%改善。相对于原始基线，所得结果 工作流程是improvement. Relative to the original baseline, the resulting workflow was+34.0%+34.0\%更高。higher.

F.5.3 案例 3：恢复的桥页需要成为新的证据来源Case 3: Recovered Bridge Pages Needed to Become New Evidence Sources

诊断。Diagnosis.

最令人惊讶的发现是全目标通行证候选者不是 最佳开发候选人。解决了所有目标训练示例的候选人 得分The most surprising discovery was that the all-targeted-pass candidate was not the best dev candidate. A candidate that solved all targeted training examples scored0.7870.787在dev上，但CRO发现了一个更通用的机制：恢复桥 页面本身应该作为证据来源重新阅读。在一份执着中 失败，工作流程恢复on dev, but CRO found a more general mechanism: recovered bridge pages should themselves be re-read as evidence sources. In one persistent failure, the workflow recovered大众 CrossBlueVolkswagen CrossBlue但还是失败了 恢复二阶比较页面but still failed to recover the second-order comparison page本田飞行员Honda Pilot.

法学硕士如何得出诊断。How the LLM arrived at the diagnosis.

提议者检查了跟踪并发现处理的工作流程已恢复 桥接页面作为端点。它还观察到早期的递归桥 当他们更换最新的缺失证据解析器时，尝试失败了。的 因此，成功的假设是组合的：保留较晚的解析器，但是 添加对新恢复的关系句子的递归读取 页。The proposer inspected the trace and saw that the workflow treated recovered bridge pages as endpoints. It also observed that earlier recursive bridge attempts failed when they replaced the late missing-evidence resolver. The successful hypothesis was therefore compositional: keep the late resolver, but add recursive reading over relation-bearing sentences from newly recovered pages.

生成的补丁。Generated patch.

CRO 在恢复上添加了关系线索过滤和递归桥扩展 标题：CRO added relation-cue filtering and recursive bridge expansion over recovered titles:

relation_cues = [
      "competed", "introduced", "based on", "inspired by",
      "starred", "founded", "won", "record"
  ]

  def relation_sentences(claim, title, snippet):
      return [
          sent for sent in split_sentences(snippet)
          if has_relation_cue(sent, relation_cues)
          or token_overlap(sent, claim + " " + title) >= 4
      ]

  bridge_expansion = collect_recursive_bridges(
      claim=claim,
      seed_titles=merge_titles(bridge_titles, snippet_bridges),
      known_titles=first_retrieved,
      max_depth=2,
  )

  retrieved = merge_titles(
      first_retrieved,
      bridge_titles,
      bridge_expansion,
      second_retrieved,
      gap_titles,
      third_retrieved,
  )

这将工作流程从“查找桥页”更改为“查找桥页” 并检查下一座桥。”This changed the workflow from “find a bridge page” to “find a bridge page and inspect it for the next bridge.”

电梯。Lift.

该补丁提高了开发覆盖率This patch raised dev coverage from0.7870.787 to 0.7970.797 (236/300236/300 to 239/300239/300），进一步), a further+1.0%+1.0\%改进和improvement and+35.0%+35.0\%超过基线。值得注意的是，其目标训练得分是 低于前任候选人（over baseline. Notably, its targeted-train score was lower than the previous candidate (0.8330.833与vs.1.0001.000），但其总开发量 分数更高。 CRO选择了一个 更通用的工作流程机制，而不是最适合目标的编辑 训练切片。), but its aggregate dev score was higher. CRO selected a more general workflow mechanism rather than the edit that best fit the targeted training slice.

F.6 Meta-Agent Guided Tree-RL：完整的训练配置Meta-Agent Guided Tree-RL: full training configuration

训练在 Modal 管理的 8 上进行Training is performed on Modal-managed 8×\timesH100 节点使用 SkyRL 的 GRPO 配方以及 FSDP2、梯度检查点和H100 nodes using SkyRL’s GRPO recipe with FSDP2, gradient checkpointing, and火炬编译torch.compile关于政策。每个训练步骤使用一批 16 个提示，每个提示 8 个样本，每个步骤 128 次部署。每次推出上限为 8 轮，每轮最多生成 1024 个代币，最大输入长度为 16,384 个；超过这些上限的轨迹将通过 SkyRL 的超长过滤模式进行过滤。优化器是 Adam，具有学习率on the policy. Each training step uses a batch of 16 prompts with 8 samples per prompt for 128 rollouts per step. Each rollout caps at 8 turns, 1024 maximum generated tokens per turn, and 16,384 maximum input length; trajectories that would exceed these caps are filtered via SkyRL’s overlong-filtering mode. The optimizer is Adam with learning rate5×10−75\times 10^{-7}，权重衰减 0.01，最大范数 0.1 的梯度裁剪，进行 20 步线性预热，然后在训练集上进行 10 个时期的恒定计划（总共 1,120 个步骤）。 KL损失被禁用；优点是 GRPO 标准化并按组标准化。推理使用 vLLM，具有四个张量并行大小为 2 的引擎，通过 NCCL 进行权重同步，以及, weight decay 0.01, and gradient clipping at max-norm 0.1, with a 20-step linear warm-up followed by constant schedule for ten epochs over the training set (1,120 total steps). KL loss is disabled; advantages are GRPO-normalized and standardized per group. Inference uses vLLM with four engines at tensor-parallel size 2, weight synchronization via NCCL, andGPU内存利用率=0.80gpu_memory_utilization=0.80。每 10 个训练步骤进行一次检查点和验证评估。规范的启动脚本是. Checkpoints and validation evaluations are taken every 10 training steps. The canonical launch script is实验/a4-reversible-rl/modal_smoke_train.pyexperiments/a4-reversible-rl/modal_smoke_train.py在已发布的代码库中。in the released codebase.

F.7 Meta-Agent Guided Tree-RL：元代理定性示例Meta-Agent Guided Tree-RL: meta-agent qualitative examples

树搜索的推出The tree-search rollouts inSection˜5.3将前叉选择权交给更强大的模型（hand the fork choice to a stronger model (克劳德作品 4-7claude-opus-4-7）。给定内部智能体的完整成绩单和最终奖励，它会返回一个回合). Given the inner agent’s full transcript and final reward, it returns a turnt∗∈[1,T−2]t^{*}\in[1,T{-}2]fork at 以及它将在那里运行的 bash 命令。我们通过策略的渲染器重新渲染命令，因此令牌与策略本身将发出的内容相匹配，并将其注入为其中之一to fork at and the bash command it would run there. We re-render the command through the policy’s renderer, so the tokens match what the policy itself would emit, and inject it as one of theKK分支机构在branches att∗t^{*}.

本小节将介绍显示元代理行为的三种轨迹形状：早期的单因故障、具有多个似是而非的分支的模糊故障以及具有深层嵌套错误的长轨迹。这些轨迹足够短，可以从头到尾地阅读，并且是手工构建的，因此细心的读者对“右”分支转弯有很强的优先权。我们检查元代理的选择是否与之前的匹配，其发出的命令是否真正解决了故障，以及它是否在整个轨迹长度上保持良好的行为。 （已发布的探针组中的另外三个案例，由于空间原因而被省略，包括干净成功的无操作、晚转范围夹紧以及案例 1 的冗余工具更换变体；结果与此处显示的模式匹配。）This subsection walks through three trajectory shapes that show the meta-agent’s behaviour: an early single-cause failure, an ambiguous failure with multiple plausible branches, and a long trajectory with a deeply-nested mistake. The trajectories are short enough to read end-to-end and were hand-constructed so a careful reader has a strong prior over the “right” branch turn. We check whether the meta-agent’s pick matches that prior, whether its emitted command actually addresses the failure, and whether it stays well-behaved across trajectory lengths. (Three further cases in the released probe set, omitted for space, cover clean-success no-ops, late-turn range clamping, and a redundant tool-replacement variant of Case 1; results match the patterns shown here.)

设置。Setup.

对于每种情况，我们将内部代理轨迹（系统提示、用户任务以及交替的辅助工具调用和工具结果）呈现为编号的转弯列表，并将其与最终奖励一起发送到元代理。元代理返回一个 JSON 对象For each case, we render the inner-agent trajectory (system prompt, user task, and the alternating assistant tool calls and tool results) as a numbered turn list and send it to the meta-agent along with the final reward. The meta-agent returns a JSON object{branch_turn，tool_call，原因}{branch_turn, tool_call, reason}, 其中, wheretool_call.name = “bash”tool_call.name = "bash"和andtool_call.arguments.command是 bash 有效负载。is the bash payload.

标题。Headline.

元代理的选择共享两种模式，统一采样无法重现。首先，它更喜欢下游做出错误选择的最早的回合，即使该回合本身并不是语法上明显的失败（情况 1：包名称拼写错误；情况 3：目标文件选择）。其次，当轨迹显示先兆后因的动态变化时（案例 2：在第 5 回合出现失效流程，可追溯到第 3 回合的启动问题），它会遵循因果链，而不是选择症状回合。要求可执行的 bash 命令，而不仅仅是轮索引，迫使元代理进行手动诊断（案例 2：特定的The meta-agent’s choices share two patterns uniform sampling cannot reproduce. First, it prefers the earliest turn at which a downstream wrong choice was made, even when that turn was not itself a syntactically obvious failure (Case 1: package-name typo; Case 3: target-file choice). Second, when the trajectory shows symptom-then-cause dynamics (Case 2: a defunct process surfaces at turn 5, traceable to a launch issue at turn 3), it follows the causal chain rather than picking the symptom turn. Demanding an executable bash command, not just a turn index, forces the meta-agent past hand-wavy diagnoses (Case 2: a specific诺哈普nohup调用，而不是“使用正确的启动标志”），并且命令通过策略使用的同一渲染器进行往返，因此注入分支的令牌与解析时策略自身的发射无法区分。invocation, not “use proper launch flags”), and the command round-trips through the same renderer the policy uses, so the injected branch’s tokens are indistinguishable from the policy’s own emission at parse time.

NeurIPS 论文清单NeurIPS Paper Checklist

  1. 1.

    索赔Claims

  2. 问题：摘要和引言中提出的主要主张是否准确反映了论文的贡献和范围？Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?

  3. 答：Answer:[是][Yes]

  4. 理由：摘要和§Justification: The abstract and §1陈述三个案例研究及其标题数字；每个数字都与相应的结果部分匹配并且state the three case studies and their headline numbers; every number matches the corresponding results section andTables˜3, 4和and2.

  5. 指南：Guidelines:

    • •

      答案The answer[不适用][N/A]意味着摘要和引言不包括论文中提出的权利要求。means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper.

    • •

      摘要和/或引言应清楚地说明所提出的主张，包括论文中所做的贡献以及重要的假设和限制。一个The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A[否][No] or [不适用][N/A]审稿人不会很好地理解这个问题的答案。answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.

    • •

      所提出的主张应与理论和实验结果相匹配，并反映结果可以在多大程度上推广到其他设置。The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings.

    • •

      只要论文明确没有实现这些目标，就可以将理想目标作为动机。It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper.

  6. 2.

    局限性Limitations

  7. 问题：本文是否讨论了作者所做工作的局限性？Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?

  8. 答：Answer:[是][Yes]

  9. 理由：§Justification: §A有一个专门的限制小节，涵盖存在证明框架、监督和提议者成本、反事实重放的弱耦合假设以及长期运行的有状态进程的沙箱后端警告。has a dedicated Limitations subsection covering proof-of-existence framing, supervision and proposer cost, the weak-coupling assumption of counterfactual replay, and sandbox-backend caveats for long-running stateful processes.

  10. 指南：Guidelines:

    • •

      答案The answer[不适用][N/A]表示论文没有限制，而答案means that the paper has no limitation while the answer[否][No]意味着论文有局限性，但论文中没有讨论这些局限性。means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper.

    • •

      鼓励作者在论文中创建一个单独的“局限性”部分。The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper.

    • •

      论文应指出任何强有力的假设以及结果对违反这些假设的鲁棒性如何（例如，独立假设、无噪声设置、模型良好规范、仅在局部保持的渐近近似）。作者应该反思这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反以及会产生什么影响。The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.

    • •

      作者应该反思所提出的主张的范围，例如，如果该方法仅在几个数据集或几次运行中进行了测试。一般来说，实证结果通常取决于隐含的假设，这些假设应该被阐明。The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.

    • •

      作者应该反思影响该方法性能的因素。例如，当图像分辨率较低或在低光照条件下拍摄图像时，面部识别算法可能表现不佳。或者，语音转文本系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供隐藏式字幕，因为它无法处理技术术语。The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.

    • •

      作者应该讨论所提出算法的计算效率以及它们如何随着数据集大小进行扩展。The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size.

    • •

      如果适用，作者应该讨论他们解决隐私和公平问题的方法可能存在的局限性。If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness.

    • •

      虽然作者可能担心审稿人可能会利用对限制的完全诚实作为拒绝的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现论文中未承认的限制。作者应该运用他们的最佳判断，并认识到有利于透明度的个人行动在制定维护社区完整性的规范方面发挥着重要作用。将特别指示审稿人不要惩罚有关限制的诚实行为。While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.

    • •

      答案The answer[不适用][N/A]意味着该论文不包含理论结果。means that the paper does not include theoretical results.

      论文中的所有定理、公式和证明都应编号并交叉引用。All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced.

    • •

      所有假设都应在任何定理的陈述中清楚地陈述或引用。All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems.

      相反，论文核心中提供的任何非正式证明都应由附录或补充材料中提供的正式证明进行补充。Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material.

    • •

      如果论文包含实验，If the paper includes experiments, a[否][No]审稿人不会很好地理解这个问题的答案：无论是否提供代码和数据，使论文具有可重复性很重要。answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not.

    • •

      如果贡献的是数据集和/或模型，作者应描述为使其结果可重现或可验证而采取的步骤。If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable.

    • •

      根据贡献，可以通过多种方式实现可重复性。例如，如果贡献是一种新颖的架构，充分描述该架构可能就足够了，或者如果贡献是一个特定的模型和实证评估，则可能有必要让其他人能够使用相同的数据集复制该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。一般来说。发布代码和数据通常是实现这一目标的一种好方法，但也可以通过详细说明如何复制结果、访问托管模型（例如，在大型语言模型的情况下）、发布模型检查点或适合所执行的研究的其他方式来提供可重复性。Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.

      虽然 NeurIPS 不要求发布代码，但会议确实要求所有提交内容提供一些合理的可重复性途径，这可能取决于贡献的性质。例如While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example

      1. (一)(a)

        如果贡献主要是一个新算法，论文应该明确如何重现该算法。If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm.

      2. (二)(b)

        如果贡献主要是一个新的模型架构，那么论文应该清晰、完整地描述该架构。If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully.

      3. (三)(c)

        如果贡献的是一个新模型（例如，一个大型语言模型），那么应该有一种方法来访问该模型以重现结果，或者一种重现模型的方法（例如，使用开源数据集或如何构建数据集的说明）。If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset).

      4. (四)(d)

        我们认识到，在某些情况下，再现性可能很棘手，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们提供再现性的特定方式。在闭源模型的情况下，对模型的访问可能会受到某种方式的限制（例如，注册用户），但其他研究人员应该有可能有某种途径来复制或验证结果。We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.

    更广泛的影响Broader impacts

  47. 问题：本文是否讨论了所开展工作的潜在积极社会影响和消极社会影响？Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?

    • •

      负面社会影响的例子包括潜在的恶意或非预期用途（例如，虚假信息、生成虚假个人资料、监视）、公平性考虑（例如，部署可能做出不公平地影响特定群体的决策的技术）、隐私考虑和安全考虑。Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.

    • •

      会议预计许多论文将是基础研究，不与特定应用程序相关，更不用说部署了。然而，如果存在任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应该指出。例如，可以合理地指出，生成模型质量的改进可用于生成虚假信息的 Deepfakes。另一方面，无需指出优化神经网络的通用算法可以使人们能够更快地训练生成 Deepfakes 的模型。The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.

    • •

      作者应考虑当技术按预期使用并正常运行时可能出现的危害、当技术按预期使用但给出不正确的结果时可能出现的危害、以及（有意或无意）滥用技术而造成的危害。The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.

    • •

      如果存在负面社会影响，作者还可以讨论可能的缓解策略（例如，模型的门控发布、除了攻击之外还提供防御、监控滥用的机制、监控系统如何随着时间的推移从反馈中学习的机制、提高机器学习的效率和可访问性）。If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
